BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: B.TECH   SEMESTER: III
BRANCH: CIVIL   SESSION: MO/2022

SUBJECT: CE204 BUILDING MATERIALS & CONSTRUCTION

TIME: 2 HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 25.
2. Candidates attempt for all 25 marks.
3. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
4. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
5. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc. to be supplied to the candidates in the examination hall.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------




Q1 (a) How metamorphic rock is formed? [2] CO1 L 1
Q1 (b) How the disintegration of rock takes place & what are the preservatives used? [3] CO1 L 2


Q2 (a) How will you check the well burnt brick?  [2] CO1,
CO3
L 2
Q2 (b) Why drying of brick is done before burning? [3] CO2 L 2


Q3 (a) What do you mean by calcination & slaked time? [2] CO1 L 1
Q3 (b) How is the compressive strength of cement sand mortar formed? [3] CO3 L 2


Q4 (a) What do you mean by seasoning of timber? [2] CO2 L 2
Q4 (b) What is fiber board? Write the uses of fiber board. [3] CO1 L 1


Q5 (a) Why foundation is essential for the structure? [2] CO2 L 4
Q5 (b) What do you mean by sub structure & superstructure? [3] CO2 L 1
